component.name: Xcalculator
component.summary: A calculator for Linux Mint and the Cinnamon desktop

description.p: Xcalculator is a calculator in the style of the Linux Mint X-Apps, with a classic menubar, the system theme and a history you can click to reuse earlier answers.

ul.li: Scientific: powers, roots, trigonometry, logarithms, and more
Financial: loans, savings, cash flows, and depreciation
Programmer: hexadecimal, decimal, octal, and binary, with bitwise operators
Unit Converter: twelve categories, converted as you type
Currency Converter: about 30 currencies, with exchange rates from the European Central Bank

description.p: It works to up to 50 decimal places, and can print its history like an adding-machine tape.
Spanish, French, German, and Brazilian Portuguese translations, a new icon, and a bordered history that follows the system theme.
A new Currency Converter mode, with the European Central Bank's exchange rates and optional automatic refresh.
Opening Xcalculator again opens another window, and the windows share their settings and history. Settings are now kept in ~/.config/xcalculator. Every word on screen can now be translated.
